actions.title: Sunset-aware Home hero switching
actions.acceptanceCriteria: Home hero switches to the dark/night background at actual Budapest sunset; evening background is used only before sunset; profile switching preserves correct daypart.
actions.notes: v1.43 fixes the old fixed 18:00–21:30 evening window. Sunrise/sunset is now fetched from Open-Meteo for Budapest and rechecked every minute.

actions.title: Unify current Budapest weather and sunset-aware hero
actions.acceptanceCriteria: Home weather refreshes from current Budapest Open-Meteo data; icon/condition match the live weather; hero uses the same sunrise/sunset cycle and switches to night at actual sunset.
actions.notes: v1.44 refreshes every 10 minutes, refreshes again when the app returns to foreground, and keeps a short local cache for graceful fallback.

actions.title: Show scenic daypart photographs without excessive dimming
actions.acceptanceCriteria: Both profile Home/Today heroes retain visible photographic detail in every season and daypart; autumn night shows illuminated Budapest or moonlit Rockies with the moon and water inside the frame; title remains legible.
actions.notes: v1.45 removes the full-frame 48–72% night veil and evening/day veils, uses local title shading, and installs two wide autumn night photographs. Other seasonal assets remain in the shared HERO_BG map. Browser verification is recorded after deployment.

actions.title: Own favicon and home-screen shortcut identity
actions.acceptanceCriteria: HealthHub has its own heart-and-cross favicon, Apple touch icon and separate app manifest with HealthHub-only start URL and scope; icons survive bundled page reconstruction.
actions.notes: User selected red heart with white medical cross and blue ring. ICO and 16/32/48px PNG favicons, 180px Apple icon, 96/192/512px launcher icons and maskable icon. Metadata is preserved through document.write. Existing shortcuts may need to be recreated by the user.

changeLog.summary: Added HealthHub Connect Android MVP and live Health Connect JSON receiver. Android bridge reads BP, HR, weight, glucose, SpO2 and aggregated daily steps; receiver enforces profile separation and deterministic dedupe. Verified debug APK build; phone E2E test pending.
Home hero daypart logic changed from fixed clock windows to actual Budapest sunrise/sunset. After sunset the dark/night background is applied automatically.
Unified current Budapest weather and daypart logic. Weather refreshes from Open-Meteo and the Home hero switches according to the same actual sunrise/sunset data.
Removed excessive full-image hero dimming for both profiles and all dayparts. Added wide autumn night scenes with moonlit water for Zsolt and illuminated Budapest with Danube reflections for Mónika.
Added a distinctive HealthHub heart-and-cross favicon and launcher identity, with a dedicated manifest scoped to HealthHub and icon metadata preserved during bundled HTML loading.
